posts.name: Snail Shell
posts.cooked:
Now that WotC is safely a thing, I'm sure the next question is how many more expansions will there be.  Villains seems to be another mega-expansion, which rocks.  I'm thinking more the regular expansions.

 

The math that I mention in the title comes from the Nemesis mechanic.  Four Heroes still lack a nemesis in the game (Absolute Zero, Bunker, Unity, and The Scholar), not counting Vengeance.  With two more regular expansions, we'd see four new heroes and eight new villains, bringing the total to eight each and seeing everyone get a nemesis.  Does that make sense?

 

Also, I joined the SotM bandwagon late.  Any chance there will be another design-a-baddie contest?

posts.cooked:
It is not at all clear that every hero will get a stand-alone nemesis. From the Challenge document, Absolute Zero and Bumker both appear to have members of the Vengeful Five as their primary nemesis, while the Scholar has the Biomancer who is brlieved to be on the cover of VotM.

Additionally, In response to a question about that, Christopher said that AZ, Bunker and Unity would not be getting stand-alone, non-V5 type nemeses. This does not preclude the possibility that one or more would, just that all three would not.

So the description of the forthcoming Oversized Villain Cards contains the following sentence:

 

 This set contains an oversized card for every villain which will ever be printed (other than those which come with their own oversized cards, such as the Vengeance villains).

 

This seems to indicate that the Villain mini-expansion coming with the VotM preorder (should it be a standard Villain deck) will be the last standard Villain deck we will see for Sentinels. Maybe a Hero only expansion to come but certainly no standard expansion (2H, 2E, 4V) as we have seen before. Perhaps only the final expansion is left.
